title: FiskDrive
tagline: Google drive for web3, allowing decentralized file storage and sharing.
description: This project uses lighthouse in order to store files, encrypted so that no one other than the owner can access them. The owner can then later retrieve the files safely using lighthouse as well. The owner of the files can also share the files with their friends safely with this platform.
how_its_made: This project uses lighthouse as a means for storage. It also have plans of integrating with push protocol for notification. Lighthouse is extremely useful for this project as it allows encrypted storage and easy file sharing for the users. Lighthouse SDK typing is slightly inaccurate but the discord messages helped a lot.
